verdict.rationale: A probe reports that the dos.fl.gov guidance pages remain open, and the guidance content (start-business steps, annual report instructions) was extractable as plain text, which suggests the pages are not behind a bot wall or a JS-only shell. However, no evidence explicitly confirms a fetch with an identified user agent, the absence of a CAPTCHA, or server-rendered HTML. The adjacent efile.sunbiz.org host shows an inconsistent robots.txt response, though that host is the filing surface rather than the guidance pages. missing for 10: explicit documented fetch result (status code and user agent) for the dos.fl.gov guidance pages, explicit confirmation of no CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, independent corroboration of keyless agent access.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
